services.desc: Family owned and operated Branson Landmark. Scotty’s Trout Dock is a full service marina on Lake Taneycomo located in downtown Branson. Boat rentals, Fishing Guides, Tackle, equipment, bait and expert advice are all available at Scotty’s. Branson Fishing Guide - Focused Fishing Guide Service is run by professional fisherman and Licensed Professional Fishing Guide Eric Prey. Committed to providing you with your ultimate fishing experience Eric provides personal service for individuals, groups as well as corporate outings.
